ActionInHand.description:
The action the human's executor has in hand, its occurrence in the task's expansion, and its progress in
ticks.
ActionInHand.title: ActionInHand

ActionRef.description: A grounded action: its schema's name and its bindings.
ActionRef.title: ActionRef

AdmittedProjection.description:
The admitted hypothesis's projection: the task's plan, its actions in order; `until`, the tick its last segment
ends (the decision tick − 1 + T_h).
AdmittedProjection.title: AdmittedProjection

AfterActionTrigger.description:
After the action (its schema's name) of the entry's expansion completes; `occurrence` its 0-based occurrence,
None when it occurs once.
AfterActionTrigger.title: AfterActionTrigger

AgentTick.description:
An agent at the tick: its position, and the unit direction of its most recent step that moved it (None before
it has moved), computed from its own positions.
AgentTick.title: AgentTick

Appearance.description: A domain's scene appearance: per object type its look; the agents' figures. Every field has a default.
Appearance.title: Appearance

AtCut.description: Inside the action (its occurrence), `done` of its ticks executed.
AtCut.title: AtCut

BuildFailure.description: A model that could not be built from the choice; no sim-run exists and no log pair is written.
BuildFailure.title: BuildFailure

Catalogue.description:
What can be chosen: per domain its layouts, setups and scenarios, and the run options with their values and
defaults; `default_choice` is the run file's.
Catalogue.title: Catalogue

Current.description:
The answer to current: the current sim-run with its tick updates, or the current view, or neither (both
None). At most one is set.
Current.title: Current

DecisionMade.description:
A decision of the robot: its tick, the trigger that fired and its cause (recognition_changed only), the
admission's answer then, the projection it rested on, what it did to the task, the chosen task (None when it
finishes), the hold it carries, in ticks, and the rest of the pool (the queue, unordered).
DecisionMade.title: DecisionMade

DomainEntry.description: A domain: what can be chosen in it, and its scene appearance (the defaults where it states none).
DomainEntry.title: DomainEntry

DuringActionTrigger.description: A cut `time` (as written, ISO-8601) into the action.
DuringActionTrigger.title: DuringActionTrigger

Entered.description: A script entry's task pushed on the empty stack.
Entered.title: Entered

EntryPosition.description: Which entry of the script: its part and its index there.
EntryPosition.title: EntryPosition

EventPosition.description: Which authored event of the script: its entry, and its index among the entry's events (T-viz 1a (iv)).
EventPosition.title: EventPosition

Extent.description: A size: the extent along x and along y.
Extent.title: Extent

FallbackMode.description: The fallback projection's form: the human standing where seen, or walking straight on.
FallbackMode.title: FallbackMode

FallbackProjection.description:
The fallback projection: standing or moving, over `span` ticks, to the end of tick `until` (the decision tick −
1 + T_h); the decision is re-decided after it unless another trigger fires first.
FallbackProjection.title: FallbackProjection

FixedObject.description: A fixed object of the layout, at its position for the whole sim-run (an override applied).
FixedObject.title: FixedObject

FixedObjectContents.description:
A fixed object that holds movable objects at the tick, with them in their order of arrival (at the start, the
setup's order; two arriving on one tick, the setup's order).
FixedObjectContents.title: FixedObjectContents

FixedStateLook.description: The look of a fixed object while `state` holds for it.
FixedStateLook.title: FixedStateLook

FixedTypeLook.description: A fixed object type's look, and its looks by state in order (the first whose state holds is drawn).
FixedTypeLook.title: FixedTypeLook

Gate.description:
The gate's answer for the leader, in the order admission asks (the values are the log's codes): no human
observed (asked before the gate), intention off, below θ, the leader with no observation, inadequate,
unwarranted, outranked; or it clears.
Gate.title: Gate

HoldInProgress.description:
The hold the last decision (at `decided_at`) carries, while it runs or waits behind a completion tick the body
still owes: `stood` of its `planned` ticks executed.
HoldInProgress.title: HoldInProgress

HumanActivity.description:
What a human's executor is doing at the tick, from its record: the stack, top first; the action in hand; the
stack's transitions on the tick; the script's entries still open (ordinary, then closing). T-viz 1a (iv): the script
entry each task of the stack runs (None for a task an event started), and the tag of the task on top (None with an
empty stack, or when the domain declares no context knowledge).
HumanActivity.title: HumanActivity

HumanScript.description:
A human's script: the ordinary entries of the priority list in written order, its repeatable entries, its
closing part, and whether it depends on the robot.
HumanScript.title: HumanScript

HumanWalks.description:
A human's walks ahead at the tick, in order: the walk actions of the task on top of its stack from the action
in hand on, as its executor has expanded them (only the action in hand while a cut action is being finished: the
task is expanded again after it).
HumanWalks.title: HumanWalks

Hypothesis.description:
A hypothesis of the robot's hypothesis space: its key (the label the logs and the belief use) and the task it
names, by its schema's name and its bindings.
Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis

HypothesisBelief.description:
A live hypothesis at the tick: its belief over the live hypotheses (the value the gate compares with θ), its
prior (context knowledge on; else None), its hypothesis adequacy, its tail probability S (a member of the adequacy
test; else None), its observation warrant and its evidence rank.
HypothesisBelief.title: HypothesisBelief

LayoutEntry.description:
A layout: its id, its title (stale in older layouts), and its notes, the free text of the layout file that says
what the room is for (None when it has none).
LayoutEntry.title: LayoutEntry

LayoutView.description:
The view of a layout (the space, the areas, the fixed objects) and, with a setup chosen, of the setup at its
start. No sim-run, no agent, no tick.
LayoutView.title: LayoutView

Left.description:
A task left the top of the stack, or was pushed down (suspended). `entry`: the script entry the task runs, None
for a task an event started (T-viz 1a (iv)).
Left.title: Left

LevelOption.description: A run option that is a number strictly between 0 and 1.
LevelOption.title: LevelOption

LimitOption.description: A run option that is a limit: a whole number, at least `minimum`, or no limit (None).
LimitOption.title: LimitOption

LimitValue.description: A limit's value; None: no limit.
LimitValue.title: LimitValue

MovableObject.description:
A movable object of the setup: its home container and, where the domain determines one, its designated
destination. Where it is at a tick is the tick update's.
MovableObject.title: MovableObject

MovableShape.description: The forms of a movable object.
MovableShape.title: MovableShape

MovableStateLook.description: The look of a movable object while `state` holds for it.
MovableStateLook.title: MovableStateLook

MovableTypeLook.description: A movable object type's look, and its looks by state in order (the first whose state holds is drawn).
MovableTypeLook.title: MovableTypeLook

MovingSegment.description:
A moving segment of a projection still ahead: from `start` (where the projection has the agent at the tick, for
the segment under way) to `end`; `until`: the tick it ends, on the world's clock (fractional).
MovingSegment.title: MovingSegment

NoProjection.description: No projection: no human observed, or no previous observation of it (unassessed).
NoProjection.title: NoProjection

NowTrigger.description: A live event, fired on the tick it is applied.
NowTrigger.title: NowTrigger

ObjectState.description: A declared state that holds; `object` None for a fact about no object.
ObjectState.title: ObjectState

OneOfOption.description: A run option that takes one value of a closed list.
OneOfOption.title: OneOfOption

RobotAction.description:
The action at the robot's plan's cursor, and its progress: the microactions of its expansion executed, in
ticks (0 of 0: not yet begun).
RobotAction.title: RobotAction

RobotBelief.description:
The recognizer's outputs at the tick: the leader (None when exhausted) and its belief, the lifecycle, the
adequacy finding (None when exhausted), whether the tick is an episode boundary, every live hypothesis in the
recognizer's order; with context knowledge on, the foreseeable tasks' levels and the recency facts of the robot's
memory of observed completions (the tasks by their schemas' names).
RobotBelief.title: RobotBelief

RobotBody.title: RobotBody

RobotCondition.description:
The robot's condition in the sim-run (glossary §9): as designed; observing the human's motion without its
intention (the recognizer does not run, the gate admits nothing); or not taking the human into account.
RobotCondition.title: RobotCondition

RobotDescription.description:
What is constant in a sim-run about a robot's mind: its condition; the human it observes (None when it observes
none); θ, the gate's share; the adequacy test's level α; min_separation, in the layout's unit; whether context
knowledge acts on its prior; its hypothesis space, in the recognizer's order; its own assigned tasks; the observed
human's assigned tasks it knows (assignment knowledge; None when off).
RobotDescription.title: RobotDescription

RobotTick.description:
A robot at the tick: its body; its belief (None while the recognizer has produced none: intention-unaware,
human-unaware, or before the first step); the gate's answer for the leader at the tick (the gate is asked at a
decision; this is what it would answer now); and its last decision, kept on every tick after it (None before the
first). The hypothesis a decision rests on (the decision record) is its admitted projection's.
T-viz 1d and 1e: `walks_ahead`, the robot's own walks ahead (the walk actions of its plan from its cursor on);
`projection_ahead`, the segments of its last decision's projection of the human still ahead at the tick, in order
(its kind is `decision.projection`'s; empty with no projection, and past its end).
RobotTick.title: RobotTick

RunDescription.description:
Everything constant in one sim-run, sent when its model is built: the triple, the run options as the
screen-user stated them and as the model applies them (an option set off by another shows here), and the world.
RunDescription.title: RunDescription

RunEnd.description: The sim-run's end: why, and the entries still open of each script that depends on the robot.
RunEnd.title: RunEnd

RunTick.description:
The facts of the sim-run at the tick that are neither the world's nor the robot's mind's. `finished_at`: the
first tick at which every human's script had ended (every entry closed, the stack empty) and every robot's task
pool was empty (the tick of its empty-pool log line); None before. Once set, it is kept.
RunTick.title: RunTick

ScenarioEntry.description:
A scenario with its two bindings: the one setup it binds and its reference layouts (the first is the one a
run takes when it names no layout). A run on another layout of the domain is valid and never a baseline.
ScenarioEntry.title: ScenarioEntry

Separation.description:
The distance between a robot and a human over the tick, the values the run log's `[sep]` line prints:
`distance` at the end of the tick, `minimum` the continuous minimum over the tick (both agents moving in a straight
line from their previous positions); `below`: the minimum lies under the robot's min_separation (the analyses'
count of ticks below it). In the layout's unit.
Separation.title: Separation

SetupEntry.description: A setup: its id and its notes, the free text of the setup file (None when it has none).
SetupEntry.title: SetupEntry

SetupView.description:
A setup's part of a view: its movable objects in the setup's order, the fixed objects that hold them at the
start (each with them in the setup's order), and the object states that hold at the start.
SetupView.title: SetupView

ShapeKind.description: The forms of a fixed object, drawn over its footprint.
ShapeKind.title: ShapeKind

SimRunChoice.description:
The screen-user's choice of a sim-run: the domain, the layout, the scenario (its setup is the scenario's) and
a value for every run option the catalogue declares.
SimRunChoice.title: SimRunChoice

SimRunHistory.description:
A sim-run with every tick update it has given, in order: the start's first, then one per step (the last
carrying the end when it has ended). The page derives from the sequence what a single tick does not hold (the
display places, T-viz 1a (iii)), so that a reload keeps the picture.
SimRunHistory.title: SimRunHistory

SimRunRef.description: The body of a request on one sim-run (step, reset).
SimRunRef.title: SimRunRef

SimRunState.description:
A sim-run as the page needs it to draw: its run description and its latest tick update (the start's before
the first step). The answer to choose and reset.
SimRunState.title: SimRunState

Started.description:
A task pushed on the stack by an event; `where` on the task below it, None on an empty stack. `event`: the
script's event that fired, None for a live event (T-viz 1a (iv)).
Started.title: Started

StationarySegment.description:
A stationary segment of a projection still ahead (a stand): the agent expected at `position` until `until`, on
the world's clock (fractional); consecutive ones at one place are one.
StationarySegment.title: StationarySegment

StepRefusal.description:
A step or a reset refused: the sim-run is not the current one, it has ended (a step only), or a step of it is
under way.
StepRefusal.title: StepRefusal

StillOpen.description: An entry still open where the script stops being followed (a script that depends on the robot).
StillOpen.title: StillOpen

SwitchOption.description: A run option that is on or off.
SwitchOption.title: SwitchOption

TagValue.description: The tag per task (glossary §7; world/tag.py): a label of the world, never the robot's.
TagValue.title: TagValue

TaskChange.description:
What the decision did to the robot's task: starts one (it had none), continues it (the same task, task
equality), switches to another, or finishes (the pool is empty).
TaskChange.title: TaskChange

TaskLevel.description: A foreseeable task's strength level on the tick (context knowledge on), by its schema's name.
TaskLevel.title: TaskLevel

TaskRef.description:
A task instance: its schema's name and its bindings; `label` is the framework's derived label, the text the
logs show. `identity` (T-viz 1c): the task's identity in the framework's sense (task equality: the schema and its
goal bindings, without a determined or a duration binding), written as a hypothesis key is written, so that it
equals the key of the hypothesis that names the task (`Hypothesis.key`). Two tasks are the same task exactly when
their identities are equal.
TaskRef.title: TaskRef

TaskTagged.description:
The tag of the task on top of the stack, by the facts in force at its stretch's first tick `since` (world/tag.py):
the foreseeable tasks at the raised and at the suppressed level then, by their schemas' names.
TaskTagged.title: TaskTagged

TimelineWindow.description: A timeline fact holds on the ticks [start, until); `until` None: to the run's end.
TimelineWindow.title: TimelineWindow

Unfired.description: An authored event that will not fire; `position`: where the script states it (T-viz 1a (iv)).
Unfired.title: Unfired

ViewChoice.description: The body of a view request: a layout of the domain, and optionally a setup.
ViewChoice.title: ViewChoice

ViewRefusal.description: A view refused: a sim-run that has been stepped is current, and the choices are locked until a reset.
ViewRefusal.title: ViewRefusal

Walk.description:
A walk ahead of an agent: one walk action of its current task (an action whose schema names a movement target),
from `start` in a straight line to `end`. `start`: the agent's position for the walk in hand, else where the walk
before it stops; `end`: where the body's walk stops (its first step within the `at` radius of the target's
position); `target`: the object the walk action heads for. A walk the body has completed has none.
Walk.title: Walk

WorldTick.description:
The world at the tick. Every movable object is in exactly one of `fixed_object_contents` and `carried`.
`separations` (T-viz 1c): per robot and human, after a step; empty at the start. `walks_ahead` (T-viz 1d): per
human, its walks ahead, a world fact the robot does not know.
WorldTick.title: WorldTick
